  • Method Details

    • createAppointment

      public boolean createAppointment(Appointment appointment)
      Creates a new appointment if it does not duplicate an existing one.

      Two appointments are considered duplicates if they share:

      • Same patient
      • Same doctor
      • Same date/time (down to the minute)
      Parameters:
      appointment - the appointment to be added
      Returns:
      true if appointment was successfully created, false otherwise

    • cancelAppointment

      public boolean cancelAppointment(int appointmentId)
      Cancels an existing appointment by ID by marking its status as CANCELLED.
      Parameters:
      appointmentId - the ID of the appointment to cancel
      Returns:
      true if cancellation succeeded, false if not found

    • modifyAppointment

      public boolean modifyAppointment(int appointmentId, Patient patient, Doctor doctor, LocalDateTime newDateTime)
      Modifies an existing appointment by updating its patient, doctor, and date/time.
      Parameters:
      appointmentId - the ID of the appointment to modify
      patient - the new patient object
      doctor - the new doctor object
      newDateTime - the new appointment date/time
      Returns:
      true if the appointment was modified, false otherwise

    • getAppointmentsForUser

      public ArrayList<Appointment> getAppointmentsForUser(User user)
      Retrieves all appointments associated with a specific user.

      Rules:

      • If user is a Patient → return all appointments in which they are the patient
      • If user is a Doctor → return all appointments in which they are the doctor
      Parameters:
      user - the user whose appointments should be returned
      Returns:
      a list of matching appointments (empty if none or if user is invalid)
